featured_reviews.review_text:
I had a very smooth and satisfactory experience with my claim process at HDFC ERGO Health Insurance. The entire journey—from hospitalization to claim settlement—was handled efficiently and transparently.
The cashless claim process was quick, and the coordination between the hospital and the insurance team was well managed. There were clear communications at every step, and the approval process did not cause unnecessary delays. Most importantly, there were minimal deductions, which reflects fair claim assessment.
I would also like to specially mention Niraj Shinde – Health Insurance Expert, who helped me select the right policy. His knowledge of health insurance is excellent, and he guided me properly based on my needs. During the claim process as well, he was very helpful, supportive, and always available for assistance.
This experience reinforced the importance of having a good health insurance policy. In medical emergencies, financial stress can be significant, but with the right insurer and expert guidance, the burden becomes much lighter.
I would strongly recommend everyone not to delay buying health insurance. A reliable policy not only provides financial protection but also ensures peace of mind during critical times.
Overall, I appreciate HDFC ERGO for their prompt service, transparency, and customer support.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Thank you so much for your detailed and thoughtful 5-star review. I'm truly grateful for your trust and kind words. It was my pleasure to help you choose the right HDFC ERGO Health Insurance policy and support you throughout your claim journey. Knowing that you had a smooth claim experience and felt well supported means a lot to me. Your recommendation motivates me to continue providing honest advice, prompt assistance, and dedicated claim support. Wishing you and your family good health and happiness always. Thank you once again! 🙏😊

owner_posts.post_text:
The ABSLI Guaranteed Annuity Plus is a non-linked, non-participating, general annuity plan which is ideal for anyone wanting secure, lifelong retirement income. With a wide range of annuity and deferment options, along with premium return and top-up features, it caters to evolving retirement needs.
The key features of this plan are:
•	Guaranteed# lifetime income with your choice of payout frequency: monthly, quarterly, half-yearly, or yearly.
•	Deferred annuity lets you lock current rates and start payouts later (5 - 15 years).
•	Top-up option allows you to increase annuity later, subject to terms.
•	Surrender & loan facilities available under select options (e.g., ROP-linked, deferred).
•	Return of Purchase Price to the nominee on death of the annuitant depending on the plan option chosen.

ABSLI Saral Jeevan Bima is a simple, non-linked, non-participating pure term insurance plan that provides a lump-sum payout to the nominee on the death of the life insured. It offers flexible premium payment options (Single, Limited, or Regular Pay) with coverage for up to 40 years.
The key features are:
•	Death Benefit: Lump sum payable on death (post 45-day waiting period); no maturity or survival benefits.
•	Premium Payment: Single, Limited (5/10 years), or Regular Pay.
•	Sum Assured: ₹5 lakhs to ₹25 lakhs.
•	Waiting Period: 45 days from policy start (only accidental death covered during this period).
•	Entry Age: 18 - 65 years | Policy Term: 5 - 40 years.
•	Optional Rider: Accidental Death Benefit Rider Plus.

The ABSLI Salaried Term Plan is a non-linked non-participating individual pure risk premium life insurance plan which is a versatile and cost-effective insurance solution for salaried professionals, offering multiple payout formats, health benefits, and optional riders. It’s ideal if you want tailored protection, premium refunds, or structured income benefits for your dependents.

The Benefits of this plan are:
•	Term Plan exclusively designed Salaried Individuals.
•	In-built Terminal Illness Benefit: Immediate payment of 50% of sum assured (max ₹2 crore), waiver of future premiums if diagnosed before age 70.
•	Optional Accelerated Critical Illness Rider: Covers up to 42 specified illnesses.

ABSLI Poorna Suraksha Kawach Plan is a non-linked, non-participating term insurance plan that offers comprehensive life cover with six customizable plan options. It includes features like Return of Premium, Increasing/Decreasing Sum Assured, Waiver of Premium on critical illness or disability, and Terminal Illness Benefit. Optional Critical Illness cover can also be added.
The Key features of this plan are:
•	Plan Options: Level Cover, Return of Premium, Early Return of Premium, Increasing/Decreasing Cover, Waiver on CI/TPD.
•	Death Benefit: Lump sum payout on death (based on chosen option).
•	Maturity* Benefit: Available under Return/ One Time Return of Premium options.
•	Terminal Illness Benefit: 50% of Sum Assured paid in advance.
•	Entry Age: 18 to 65 years | Policy Term: 5 to 55 years.
•	Minimum Sum Assured: ₹30 lakhs | Premium Modes: Single, Limited, or Regular Pay.

The ABSLI Platinum Gain Plan is a unit-linked, non-participating individual life insurance savings plan (ULIP) that combines life cover with market-linked investment options - risk borne by the policyholder. This plan offers sophisticated fund-management features and wealth-boosting elements, making it a compelling ULIP for experienced investors. 
The benefits of this plan are:
•	Death Benefit: Higher of Sum Assured (adjusted for last 2 years’ withdrawals), Fund Value, or 105% of total premiums paid.
•	Maturity1 Benefit: Fund Value plus refund of mortality & premium allocation charges, available as lump sum or via structured payouts.
•	Partial/Full Liquidity: Allowed only after 5-year lock-in.

The ABSLI Nishchit Aayush Plan is a non-linked non-participating individual savings life insurance plan that offers a blend of stable income, lump sum maturity benefits, and life protection. With abundant customization across term, income type, and payout frequency, it's a structured choice for financially prudent individuals seeking certainty and flexibility. Riders provide added coverage. Its non-linked, non-participating nature ensures conservative, low-risk design.
The features of this plan are:
•	Benefit Options: Long Term Income (for a fixed policy term) and Whole Life Income (till age 100)
•	Income Variants (choose one): Level Income (with or without lumpsum or return-of-premium or Enhanced Lumpsum) or Increasing Income (rises ~5% every 5 years) 
•	Deferment Choice: Start income payouts immediately or they can be defered till 5 years, based on deferment choice.

ABSLI Guaranteed Milestone Plan is a non-linked, non-participating life insurance savings plan that offers guaranteed maturity and death benefits along with monthly guaranteed additions throughout the policy term. It ensures financial protection and disciplined savings with zero market risk.
The key features of this plan are:
•	Guaranteed# Additions: Credited monthly during the policy term.
•	Death Benefit: Higher of 15× annual premium, 105% of premiums paid, or Maturity Sum Assured (with additions).
•	Maturity Benefit1: Maturity Sum Assured + accrued Guaranteed Additions.
•	Policy Term: 12 to 26 years; Premium Payment Term: 6 to 12 years (varies with term).
•	Joint Life Cover: Optional cover for spouse.
•	Entry Age: 30 days to 60 years.
•	Minimum Premium: ₹15,000 annually.

The ABSLI DigiShield Plan is a non-linked non-participating individual pure risk premium life insurance plan that offers flexible and comprehensive term insurance that adapts to changing life stages - via increasing SA, income benefits, survival payouts, and Return of Premium. The health and milestone benefits further strengthen its appeal.
The key benefits of this plan are:
•	Death Benefit: Lump sum income, or combo - based on option selected.
•	Terminal Illness Cover: Up to 50% SA, max ₹2 Cr, with premium waiver.
•	Accelerated Critical Illness (ACI): Lump sum payout on first diagnosis of 42 covered illnesses; reduces death benefit proportionately.
•	Enhanced Life-Stage Protection: Option to increase SA without medicals upon marriage, childbirth, or house loan events.
•	Flexible Riders: Add-ons available include Accidental Death & Disability, Hospital Care, Surgical Care, Critical Illness, and Waiver of Premium.

The ABSLI Assured Savings Plan is a non-linked non-participating individual savings life insurance plan that offers a secure way to accumulate wealth with guaranteed1 maturity payout and life cover, making it appealing to conservative investors seeking stability and financial protection.
The Key features of this plan are:
•	Guaranteed Maturity Benefit: Receive a guaranteed lump sum at maturity.
•	Loyalty Additions: Annual bonuses added after paying all premiums.
•	Life Cover: Death benefit during policy term; joint life protection (optional spouse cover) available.
•	Flexible Terms: Premium Pay Terms and Premium Modes.
•	High Sum Assured Limits: No upper cap on sum assured (subject to underwriting), with minimum premium specified per payment term.

ABSLI Assured Income Plus is a non-linked non-participating individual savings life insurance plan which is ideal if you're looking for secure, predictable income in retirement or to meet recurring financial goals, with built-in life cover and flexibility through riders.
The Key features of this plan are:
•	Benefit Options: Income only Benefit and Income with Lumpsum.
•	Guaranteed2 Long Term Income: Choose payout periods with flexible frequency.
•	Commutation: Option to commute part of future survival benefits into a discounted lump sum (based on factors like 9.27% discount rate)
•	Loyalty Additions: Annual boosts to income in form of loyalty additions.
Customizable with Riders: Optional riders include accidental death, critical illness, surgical care, hospital care, waiver of premium, etc

owner_posts.post_text: The energy, the milestones, and the moments that made the Agents’ Carnival ’26 at Valluvar Kottam Auditorium truly special. We came together to celebrate 20 glorious years of service, packed with inspiring leadership talks, dynamic cultural shows and a lot more. Watch the video to catch the best highlights, leadership insights, and high-energy performances from the event!

Close to 5,000 residents. Over 140 doctor consultations. More than 1,700 diagnostic tests. 100+ vaccinations. All free. All in Nashik.

Star Health has operationalised an Arogya Seva Kendra in Nashik, in partnership with Piramal Swasthya, offering primary healthcare services free of cost to the community.

"Good health often begins with timely access to basic healthcare services," said Mr. HIMANSHU WALIA, Whole-time Director and Chief Marketing Officer, Star Health and Allied Insurance. "Through Arogya Seva Kendras, we are helping ensure individuals and families can access consultations, screenings and preventive care closer to where they live, without financial barriers."

Star Health has always believed that Insurance is more than a claim. It is a partnership with the communities where our policyholders live, work, and raise their families.

Across Maharashtra, we operate 5 Arogya Seva Kendras. Nationally, the programme runs 32 centres across 9 states, all aimed at improving primary healthcare access in underserved communities.

Early Detection. Better Health. Healthy Tomorrow.

Star Health's CFO has been recognised at the 9th BW CFO World (BW CFO World Best CFO & Finance Strategy Excellence Awards) 2026, held on 9 June at Novotel Andheri, Mumbai.

Best CFO (Large Enterprise), Silver- awarded to Mr. Nilesh Kambli, who has been the financial backbone of Star Health through its FY26 milestones.

Excellence in Financial Transformation, Silver- awarded to Star Health Insurance, the only health insurer recognised in the category. The recognition reflects Star Health's shift to a digital-first finance and customer operations stack. Over 1 million customers used Star Health's digital health services in FY26 alone.

The awards were evaluated by a jury chaired by Mr. Ravi S former Chairman, BSE, and presented in the presence of Mr. Adv. Ashish Shelar Cabinet Minister, Government of Maharashtra.

Behind every Silver is a finance team building the rails for the next Gold.

In 2006, Star Health and Allied Insurance became India's first standalone Health Insurance company. Twenty years later, the launch of Value Plus marks the next chapter, and India's leading publications carried the story.

The Economic Times, covered Star Health's two-decade milestone alongside the launch of Value Plus.

Value Plus is an affordable Health Insurance offering designed to bring wider health protection to young Indians in Tier 2, 3 and 4 cities at nearly 20% lower premiums. It offers high sum-insured covers from ₹7.5 lakh to ₹25 lakh through a curated network of 11,000+ quality hospitals.

20 years in. The next chapter begins now.

"Insurance growth in India is no longer a metro story. The next wave will come from Tier II, Tier III and Tier IV markets.”

In an interview with Shine Jacob from Business Standard, our MD and CEO Anand Roy laid out why retail health penetration in smaller towns is non-negotiable for the country's Insurance for All by 2047 vision.

The first 20 years helped build India's health insurance category. The next 20 will be about taking protection deeper into Bharat.

"GWP up to ₹5,968 crore. Net profit up to ₹111 cr."

That was the headline takeaway in The Economic Times, on Star Health and Allied Insurance's Q4 FY26 results.

The coverage walked through the company's Q4 numbers. Net profit at ₹111 crore, a multi-fold jump from ₹50 lakh in the same quarter last year. Net Premium at ₹5,599 crore, up from ₹4,820 crore YoY. Total income at ₹4,545 crore, up from ₹3,989 crore YoY. And the underwriting loss narrowed sharply to ₹154 crore from ₹275 crore in the year-ago period.

Star Health has launched 32 Arogya Seva Kendras (ASK) under its CSR initiative to strengthen access to community-level primary healthcare across nine states, with the goal of impacting over one million lives.

In partnership with Piramal Swasthya (part of Piramal Foundation), these clinics will provide free primary healthcare services, including:

* MBBS doctor consultations
* Screening for hypertension, diabetes, and other non-communicable diseases (NCDs)
* Laboratory diagnostics and essential medicines
* Health counselling and awareness sessions
* Adult pneumococcal vaccination support, with expertise from Pfizer

With hypertension prevalence ranging from 20–40% and diabetes affecting up to 29% of adults in certain districts, this initiative highlights the urgent need for preventive and accessible primary care to address India’s growing NCD burden.

A meaningful step toward healthcare equity ensuring quality primary care reaches communities early, consistently, and close to home.

Star Health reported strong Q3 FY26 performance, supported by premium growth, disciplined underwriting, and improved operating efficiency.
The quarter reflects sustained focus on profitability, claims excellence, and customer trust.
